official_description_summary: Leave-on hair serum designed for regular personal care and surface skin maintenance.
label_directions: Use the serum once everyday. Start seeing hair regrowth after 3 months. Be consistent with your hair regimen with daily reminders & rewards on the Be Bodywise app.
ingredients: Glycerin (and) Aqua (and) Sodium Metabisulfite (and) Larix Europaea Wood Extract (and) Glycine (and) Zinc Chloride (and) Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract (Redensyl)
Pisum Sativum (Pea) Sprout Extract (and) Phenoxyethanol (and) Sodium Benzoate (and) Aqua (Anagain)
Butylene Glycol (and) Aqua (and) PPG-26-Buteth-26 (and) PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil (and) Apigenin (and) Oleanolic Acid (and) Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 (Procapil)

Propanediol (and) Aqua (and) Arginine (and) Lactic Acid (and) Glycine Soja (Soybean) Germ Extract (and) Triticum Vulgare (Wheat) Germ Extract (and) Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract (and) Sodium Benzoate (and) Gluconolactone (and) Calcium Gluconate (Baicapil)
